# Valuation of a bank

How we value a bank differs from an industrial company.

We use a dividend-discount model, because a bank's earnings are
driven by its loan book and its net interest margin rather than by
gross product revenue.

1. Forecast the dividend for the next three years.
2. Estimate the cost of equity.
3. Compute the present value of the dividend stream.

The rate risk sensitivity of the loan book is documented separately.
